name: Moghulistan
alt: Eastern Chagatai Khanate (khanate of the Moghuls)

predecessors.name: Chagatai Khanate
predecessors.text: the Moghul khanate after Esen Buqa II's death in 1462: 'in the west Yunus Khan gained power, while in the east Esen Buqa's son Dost Muhammad became khan'

successors.name: Yarkent Khanate (Eastern Moghulistan)
successors.text: the Tarim Basin, the Yarkent Khanate of Sultan Said Khan

successors.name: Turpan Khanate
successors.text: Turpan, 'the eastern division of Moghulistan', founded by Ahmad Alaq in 1487 and ruled by Mansur Khan from 1503

ledger.x: 1463: the Moghul khanate divides and Yunus Khan holds the west.
1512: Cliopatria joins the Moghul lands again.
1514: Said Khan founds the Yarkent Khanate.
1518: Cliopatria ends the Moghulistan row; Eastern and Western Moghulistan follow in 1519.

wars.name: Moghul succession war after Esen Buqa II (1462-1469)
wars.outcome: The khanate divided in 1462 between Yunus Khan in the west and Dost Muhammad in the east; Dost died in 1468 or 1469 and Yunus reunited the khanate.

wars.name: Yunus Khan's capture of Tashkent (1484)
wars.outcome: Yunus Khan took Tashkent from the Timurids in 1484 during the conflicts between Sultan Ahmad and Umar Shaikh Mirza II; he died there in 1487.

wars.name: Kyrgyz advance in the Tian Shan (to 1510-1511)
wars.outcome: The Kyrgyz 'gained ground in the Tian Shan' and by 1510-11 had 'effectively driven out the Moghuls'; Cliopatria's Zhetysu stays with the Eastern Chagatai Khanate row to 1511.

wars.name: Mansur Khan's conquest of Hami (1513)
wars.outcome: 'Mansur conquered the kingdom and brought the region under his control in 1513' (Turpan Khanate page); Moghulistan page: Mansur Khan 'captured Hami from Kara Del, a Mongol dependency of Ming China, in 1513'.

wars.name: Sultan Said Khan's conquest of Kashgar (1514)
wars.outcome: Said Khan took Kashgar in 1514, 'dethroning Mirza Abu Bakr', and united the Tarim cities into the Yarkent Khanate ('Altishahr'); the Moghulistan khanate was 'permanently divided'.

certainty.note: Steppe and oasis frontiers; no page gives a line.
